column1: # Sampson C.C., Metaxas P.J., Barwood M.T.J., Sinclair-Adamson R., Falloon P.E., Stanwix P.L., Johns M.L., May E.F. (2023).
# Experimental solid-liquid equilibria and solid formation kinetics for carbon dioxide in methane for LNG processing.
# AIChE J. 69(4), e18001. doi:10.1002/aic.18001. Open access: "Creative Commons Attribution License" (p. 1 of the PDF).
# Local copy: sampson-2023-aiche-aic18001.pdf
# Table 2, "Measured solid-liquid equilibrium data for the carbon dioxide + methane binary system", p. 5, read from a
# 200 dpi render; compositions and their uncertainties from Table 1 (p. 4, text layer).
# Method: synthetic, stepped melting observed by microscope; x_CO2 is the loaded (overall) mixture composition, i.e. the
# liquid composition at the melting (solubility) temperature. Solvent: pure CH4 (99.9995 mol %). Compressed liquid at 7 to
# 10 MPa, no vapour: true SLE. Kinetics (Table 3) not transcribed.
# Units as printed: x in ppm (mol), p in MPa, T in K. u_T_K = combined standard (k = 1) uncertainty as printed (+-);
# u_x_ppm from Table 1 (500 +- 5.0, 100 +- 1.0, 65.8 +- 0.9, 52.2 +- 0.6 ppm). Standard uncertainty in pressure 0.08 MPa.
# The 65.8 ppm value is the average of two melting experiments, the 52.2 ppm value the average of three.
# steps = temperature step and minimum hold per step; range_K = temperature range of the steps, both as printed.
# Their PR (ThermoFAST) kij for CO2 + CH4 tuned to these points: 0.1580 (RMS 1.07 K); previous default 0.1105.
# Sanity check: T_meas rises with x_CO2 (106.3 K at 52 ppm to 122.8 K at 500 ppm) and is nearly pressure-independent
# Digits as printed, one sanity check, not re-verified (owner: not looking for 100 % correct data).
# Role: G5 trace liquidus at LNG temperatures. Transcribed 2026-09-25, batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature.
